authors: I. Jack, D.R.T. Jones, C.G. North
title: Scheme dependence and the NSVZ beta-function
claim: A coupling redefinition delta g (starting at two loops, delta g = -(1/4) beta_g^(2)) relates DRED and NSVZ gauge beta-functions; abelian three-loop DRED graphs plus four structural requirements fix the full non-abelian three-loop DRED beta (agreeing with Avdeev-Tarasov for pure SYM); the four-loop DRED beta is obtained up to one undetermined parameter alpha_1 (later fixed in S1e.04_JJP1998). Conclusion: there exists a scheme in which NSVZ holds, perturbatively related to DRED, up to four loops.
loop_order: 3 loops (gauge beta, non-abelian inferred), 4 loops (up to one parameter)
scheme: Superspace DRED with minimal subtraction in super-Feynman gauge (vector two-point function, D^2 Dbar^2 shortcut, Sec. 2); four-loop: partial abelian O(g^3 Y^6) computation (Sec. 3).
symmetry_argument: SUSY manifest in superspace; the DRED vs NSVZ comparison is a scheme-equivalence statement (existence of a coupling redefinition), not a test of SUSY preservation by DRED; the paper makes no claim on DRED SUSY preservation.

proved: Abelian three-loop DRED vector self-energy (Sec. 2); with stated requirements, uniqueness of delta g up to a constant fixed by the abelian result; agreement with Avdeev-Tarasov pure-SYM three-loop result.
assumed: Four structural requirements on delta g used to extend from abelian to non-abelian (Sec. 2).
Four-loop: coefficient of tr[M C(R)] deduced from a Yukawa redefinition making gamma^(3) vanish in one-loop-finite theories (Sec. 3).
checked_partially: Four-loop: six terms matched with two parameters (alpha_2=-2/3, alpha_3=1/6) - a non-trivial consistency; alpha_1 undetermined.
Remarks that epsilon-scalar contributions to background-field superspace counterterms beyond one loop may obstruct an all-orders construction.

evidence: Sec. 2: abelian three-loop computation, Figs. 1-2, Table 1; delta g = -(1/4) beta_g^(2); 'quite non-trivial' check.
Sec. 3: four-loop partial computation, Fig. 3, Table 2; parameters alpha_1, alpha_2, alpha_3.
Secs. 1, 4: existence of an NSVZ scheme related to DRED.
red_flags: Consistency with NSVZ up to a coupling redefinition is a scheme statement: it does not test whether DRED preserves SUSY Ward identities; non-abelian three-loop DRED result was inferred, not computed (later confirmed directly, S1e.05_HJKMS2006).
Equation numbers garbled in the ar5iv extraction; only section-level references verified.
cross_checks: Avdeev-Tarasov three-loop pure SYM DRED beta (agreement); S1e.04_JJP1998 fixes alpha_1.
notes: Lead correct. Answer to brief: the paper explicitly frames the comparison as scheme equivalence, not as a SUSY test.
